directive.quote:
A Workshop route tool is an ordinary `ai-tool-descriptor` row (invoke kind container, `stdout: json`, stdin filled from
input) that reads and writes the person's records only through the records door

job: answer the content formats page routes over the records door: read the saved formats record, hand the owner its source readers over the person's files and pursuit records, write the saved list back

distinct_from.why: This tool itself: the owner it runs is read-data/content-formats.mjs, ported byte for byte first (ports/content-formats.json); this file only reads and writes through the door and answers the route.

The old account resource handed the owner readers over its hosted Namespace HTTP and its engine's pursuits; that host is retired and no records-door run can reach it, so the readers here read the same folders and fields through the files door and the pursuit records.
